_about: How to estimate XP remaining in a student's Math Academy course from Timeback alone. The size of every course is Timeback's own course.metadata.metrics.totalXp, which the school sets from Math Academy's published XP-with-reviews figure per course. Read it LIVE from GET /ims/oneroster/rostering/v1p2/courses/{course.sourcedId}; this file carries the rules and points at the course ids, never a copy of the figure. remaining ≈ course.metadata.metrics.totalXp × (1 − pctCompleteApp/100).
rules: Take the student's current Math Academy enrollment (active, in its date window, primary preferred) and read enrollment.metadata.pctCompleteApp and course.sourcedId.
GET the course by sourcedId and read metadata.metrics.totalXp. remaining = totalXp × (1 − pctCompleteApp/100), basis 'timeback course XP'.
totalXp absent on the course (the bare 'Math Academy' course and the Beyond AI courses as of 2026-09-17) → no estimate; say the course carries no XP figure.

SAT Math Prep (use = never) → no estimate at all: Math Academy reports an estimated SAT score there instead of progress, so pctCompleteApp on that course is stale or absent. SAT Math Fundamentals still reports progress and is estimated like any other course.
pctCompleteApp absent on the enrollment → no estimate yet (no event has arrived; DICTIONARY trap 3).
The course figure is expected to equal Math Academy's XP-with-reviews for that course. Where the school has not yet set it, the estimate reads low; the measuring query is DICTIONARY trap 11's.
courses_note: Course ids and titles are in reference/timeback-math-academy-courses.json; regenerate with GET .../courses/?filter=title~'Math Academy'.
retired: Until 2026-09-17 this file carried a per-course size calibrated against the Math Academy API. The owner ruled that Timeback's course totalXp is the figure to use and is correcting the courses whose figure was low; the calibration was removed so there is one basis, read live.
